@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8f80
+title: Multi-select attachments into the host inspector (EK selection model)
+---
+Requested by Testudo (testudoapp-bf, 2026-11-05) for its multi-file inspector capture (Testudo ^z3xr560). Rule: a kit feature needs no host glue.
+
+## Today (AVK 79c0c2d7)
+- `AttachmentInspectorMode.host(Binding<AgentAttachmentSelection?>)` holds one value; each tap replaces it.
+- `InspectorSelectable` (AttachmentView.swift) and `ImageView.select(data:)` use a plain `.onTapGesture` that ignores modifiers.
+- AVK's `InspectorSelection` holds a single attachment.
+
+## What
+- Follow EK's selection model, as chat rows do: a plain click selects one, Command-click adds or removes one, Shift-click extends the range in transcript order.
+- **Host API:** an ordered list of selections, e.g. `.host(Binding<[AgentAttachmentSelection]>)`. Keep it ordered so AttachmentInspector folds them in selection order. AVK's own `InspectorSelection` holds the same list.
+- AttachmentInspector shows the selection folded (it already takes `[Attachment]`, and Mixed rows already work).
+- **Accessibility:** each attachment exposes named actions for select, "Add to Selection" and "Extend Selection", so tests and VoiceOver can do what Command- and Shift-click do. Tests drive these actions, never the mouse.
+- **Breaking change:** replacing the single-value `host` binding breaks Testudo. Grep the KVK, SVK and Testudo origin mains first. No shim: send testudoapp-bf the local SHA and the new API shape before pushing, and pair the pushes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Hosted tests: select one; add with the Add action; remove by adding again; extend over a range; plain select replaces; the inspector shows them folded with Mixed rows. Headless, no focus stealing.
+- [ ] Gallery: the multi-file inspector in light and dark.
+- [ ] Full AVK suite green.
\ No newline at end of file

+    - EK has no click-modifier selection model of its own: its "selection model" is the scope contribution `$0.selection` read by `@FromSelection` (KVK's BoardView uses it) plus the shared `.selectableSurface`. KVK's cards read the click with `TapGesture().modifiers(...)` (BoardCardClickAction). AgentRowList is single-select through `system.geometry.requestFocus`.
+    - Selectable files of a thread: InspectorSelectable in AttachmentView, ImageView (async block-file write), ToolCallLocationChips; all go through `AttachmentSelectAction` (`\.attachmentSelect`).

Plan: each InspectorSelectable registers its file with the transcript position of its row (env, set in ConversationView) and its frame in the row (named coordinate space); the range sorts by (row position, minY, minX); views outside a row sort after the rows.
+    - Sibling mains: KVK and SVK do not use the API. Testudo uses `.agentAttachmentInspector(.host(Bindable(window).attachmentSelection))` with `var attachmentSelection: AgentAttachmentSelection?` (WindowModel+Selection.swift), `AttachmentInspector(attachment)` (InspectorAreaView.swift) and builds `AgentAttachmentSelection` in SAHKitTests/InspectorSelectionTests.swift.
